changes.eligibility: Middle school grades5–8, high school grades9–12, or undergraduate college students residing in the U.S./Canada or with a U.S. military address. Submit a one-to-three-minute video on a current prompt.

financial_aid_corrections.old: You have to opt in on the FAFSA / schools generally only consider you if you've checked that box
financial_aid_corrections.replace_text: Submit the FAFSA to be considered for Federal Work-Study. Your school determines eligibility and available funding. Check your financial aid offer, then ask the financial aid or student employment office how to apply for available jobs.

financial_aid_corrections.old: File as soon as the application opens—even with estimated information if needed
financial_aid_corrections.replace_text: File early using the tax year and information requested by that year's FAFSA. Provide consent for the IRS transfer when requested. If your household finances have changed or you cannot provide required information, contact your school's financial aid office for help rather than guessing.

discount_corrections.name: Headspace for Students
discount_corrections.description: Paid student subscription for eligible college and university students age 18+. Verify enrollment through SheerID and check current annual pricing and renewal terms.
discount_corrections.facts: Official FAQ lists $9.99 USD/year; free-year claim is false.

discount_corrections.name: Calm for Prime Student
discount_corrections.facts: Calm lists the Amazon Prime Students promotion under Offers No Longer Available.

discount_corrections.name: Canva for Education
discount_corrections.title: Canva Campus / Free Canva
discount_corrections.description: Canva Education is free for eligible K–12 schools and their students. College students should check whether their institution provides Canva Campus; a college email alone does not unlock free Pro.

discount_corrections.name: Apple Music & Apple One
discount_corrections.title: Apple Music Student
discount_corrections.description: Discounted Apple Music for eligible higher-education students, with Apple TV access subject to the current offer. Check eligibility and renewal terms on Apple's site.
discount_corrections.facts: Official Apple Music page identifies a Student Plan; Apple One is a separate bundle, not a student discount.

discount_corrections.name: Amazon Prime Student
discount_corrections.title: Prime for Young Adults
discount_corrections.description: Amazon's discounted Prime membership for eligible young adults and higher-education students. Verification can use age or student enrollment; a .edu address is not the only route.
discount_corrections.facts: Official Amazon announcement lists ages 18–24, $7.49/month or $69/year and eligible new-member trial. Avoid hardcoding trial length or price unless maintaining offer dates.

discount_corrections.name: Hulu Student Plan
discount_corrections.title: Disney+, Hulu Student Bundle
discount_corrections.description: An ad-supported Disney+ and Hulu bundle for eligible U.S. college and graduate students age 18+. Enrollment is verified through SheerID and must be re-verified annually.
discount_corrections.facts: Current official student landing page lists $6.49/month, not the old $1.99/month Hulu-only offer.

discount_corrections.name: Nike Student Discount
discount_corrections.description: Eligible U.S. students age 16+ can verify through SheerID for a single-use discount code on eligible Nike.com and Nike App purchases. Product exclusions apply.
discount_corrections.facts: US verification is SheerID, not UNiDAYS/Student Beans.

discount_corrections.name: Amtrak student fares
discount_corrections.description: Amtrak offers student fares with age, route, fare-class, advance-purchase and ID requirements. Check the current national or regional offer before booking.
discount_corrections.facts: Current national terms list 15% off for ages 17–24, valid student ID and one-day advance purchase; a separate older marketing page says ages 13–25/three days. Link current terms and avoid assuming one universal rule.

discount_corrections.name: T-Mobile Student Discounts
discount_corrections.description: Dedicated Student Perks plans for eligible college students age 18+ who are the primary account holder. Verify enrollment within 45 days and re-verify annually; taxes, fees and plan requirements apply.
discount_corrections.facts: Current student plans do exist. Do not remove the offer as fabricated.

discount_corrections.name: Peloton App Student Membership
discount_corrections.description: Verified university students can access special pricing on eligible Peloton App plans. Check membership tier, verification and current renewal pricing.

discount_corrections.name: Codecademy student discount
discount_corrections.description: Codecademy Pro Student provides eligible students discounted access to the coding curriculum. Check current annual pricing, trial and verification terms.

internship_corrections.name: Home Depot Summer Internship
internship_corrections.display_deadline: 2027 summer applications closed Oct 23, 2026; check next cycle
internship_corrections.description: Paid 11-week summer internship with business and technology projects. Official 2027 program dates are May 17–July 30, 2027.

internship_corrections.name: PGA TOUR Internship Program
internship_corrections.description: Paid eight-week internship. For the 2027 program, applicants must be enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program, have completed sophomore year by June 2027, and be authorized to work in the U.S. Written and creative responses are required.

internship_corrections.name: Smithsonian Institution Internship Program
internship_corrections.description: Internships across Smithsonian museums and research centers. Eligibility, compensation, location and dates vary by hosting unit; not all internships include a stipend.

internship_corrections.name: Google Internship Program
internship_corrections.description: Student opportunities in software engineering, UX, business, data science and other fields. Program names, eligibility and open roles vary by location and cycle; check current Google postings.
internship_corrections.limitation: Could not verify a current STEP cohort from an official source. Do not assert retirement without official evidence; simply stop advertising it as available.

internship_corrections.name: NIH Summer Internship Program
internship_corrections.description: Full-time in-person summer research for eligible community college, undergraduate, graduate and professional students, with a limited graduating-high-school route. U.S. citizenship/permanent residency and age/enrollment rules apply.

internship_corrections.name: NASA Internship
internship_corrections.description: NASA offers internship opportunities with program-specific enrollment, citizenship, GPA, age and location requirements. Confirm the current term on NASA's program page rather than assuming a single annual deadline.
internship_corrections.note: NASA GISS separately lists summer 2027 deadline Feb 26, 2027 and fall May 21, 2027, but do not apply one center's dates universally.

internship_corrections.name: The New York Times Internship Program
internship_corrections.reason: Official direct HTTPS request verified 200 and page content; web index source had been proxy-only.
internship_corrections.safe_description: Explore business and technology early-career opportunities on the employer's careers site; current openings and eligibility vary.
internship_corrections.description: Paid ten-week business and technology internships based in New York. Journalism internships were replaced by the newsroom fellowship; consult the current early-career program page for applications and eligibility.
internship_corrections.deadline_note: Official page lists Summer 2027 applications posting Oct 30, 2026 and beginning to close week of Nov 9; verify specific requisition deadlines.

internship_corrections.name: Visa Global Internship Program
internship_corrections.description: College internships in business and technology, with eligibility and dates set by the specific role and country.

internship_corrections.name: Merck Future Talent Program
internship_corrections.description: Paid internships and co-ops across research, manufacturing, technology and business. U.S. internships generally require enrollment in a bachelor's, master's or Ph.D. program and work authorization; role requirements vary.

global_copy_changes: Replace currently recruiting / live jobs claims with program directory language unless actual open requisitions are tracked.
Show source-reviewed dates at record level. HTTP 200 only verifies a URL responds, not every fact in the listing.
Remove or clearly label inherited Google review scores/counts, distance estimates and ordinal ranking. These were manually embedded without timestamps or a documented ranking method.

For housing, replace floor plans not listed online with Check current floor plans and availability on the property website when not independently verified; link the official site or honest Maps lookup.
Do not describe public directory entries as Preferred Partners unless the partnership is actually established. Separate paid placement from editorial directory entries.
Discount amounts, free-trial length, fees and renewal terms change. Prefer Discounted / Check current offer and link exact eligibility terms, with reviewed date.
limitations: 403/429/500 responses and timeouts are not proof of dead links. Preserve as unverified or replace with confirmed official evergreen pages.
Could not independently verify every one of the 66 programs' current recruiting status. Generic annual cycles must not imply applications are open.

Only Houston's five property websites and broken Sedona Ranch destinations were independently researched here. The other markets' availability, ratings, distances and apartment eligibility remain unverified.
